description: Implementation of a mDNS host resolver listener for handling DNS record updates and delegate notifications within the Chromium project.

classes.name: HostResolverMdnsListenerImpl
classes.description: Implements an mDNS listener that handles DNS record updates and notifies a delegate.

methods.name: ConvertUpdateType
methods.description: Converts internal MDnsListener update types to MdnsListenerUpdateType.

methods.name: HostResolverMdnsListenerImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener with host and query type.

methods.name: ~HostResolverMdnsListenerImpl
methods.description: Destructor ensuring proper cleanup and sequence validation.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the mDNS listener and assigns the delegate.

methods.name: OnRecordUpdate
methods.description: Handles DNS record updates and forwards results to the delegate based on query type.

methods.name: OnNsecRecord
methods.description: No-op for NSEC records, not supported.

methods.name: OnCachePurged
methods.description: No-op for cache purge events, not supported.
